Hi Carlos / Maya -

Great to meet today - thanks for walking through Valencia Tech's evaluation goals. Quick recap and proposal for next steps so we have aligned owners and a timeline: 

Success criteria (proposed):
- 95% parity on representative generation prompts vs. your current baseline (accuracy & style)
- Sub-100ms p50 latency for 1k-user simulated load on dedicated capacity
- Data controls validated: retention policy and audit logs verified by your security team

Evaluation plan:
1) Kickoff + infra onboarding (Redwood infra access + test dataset)
2) Week 1: baseline run + initial tuning (model/quantization suggestions)
3) Weeks 2: feature-specific evaluation, latency/load testing, privacy checks
4) Final readout + success decision (deliverable: readout deck + runbook)

Proposed timeline / milestones:
- Kickoff: week of Nov 15 - propose Tue Nov 16 10:00am PST
- Weekly check-ins: Tues, 30 minutes (status, blockers, next actions)
- Final readout: week of Dec 14

Ownership (Redwood):
- Marissa Cole - POC lead / kickoff & readout
- Rachel Kim - weekly check-ins / QA coordination
- Vivek Kulkarni - infra & onboarding

Attachments: Valencia_POC_plan_v1.pdf (draft timeline & responsibilities), Valencia_success_criteria.xlsx (editable)

Can you confirm: 1) that the proposed success criteria look right, 2) kickoff availability the week of Nov 15, and 3) any additional internal stakeholders we should loop in?

Thanks - happy to iterate.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142
